scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because raw DFT energies from saddle and minimum are not available; the agent computes barriers directly and reports them. We compare against paper-reported values with tolerance.

mo_barrier.description: Migration energy barrier for bcc Mo in eV

mos2_barrier.description: Migration energy barrier for MoS2 in eV

mo_dft_calls.description: Total number of DFT calculations for Mo

mos2_dft_calls.description: Total number of DFT calculations for MoS2

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the migration barriers and DFT call counts for both systems.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported barriers to the paper-reported values within ±0.15 eV tolerance and compares DFT call counts within ±10% relative difference. The exact tolerances are hidden.

steps.description: Score migration barriers and DFT call counts against paper-reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for barriers and DFT call counts
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values: vacancy migration barrier in bcc Mo (1.34 eV) and sulfur diffusion in MoS2 (2.3 eV); DFT call counts (49) from Table S2 for GPR-dimer with n_h=10, r_f=3 Å for Mo and equivalent for MoS2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers for the same conditions; they are the target reproduction quantities.
